design: submit(): prompt admission and /new share one admission lock (self.ctl); running is set under that lock before the prompt thread starts, so /new's idle check cannot race a prompt. /new: refuses on ACP_RESUME lanes, if the lock is held, or if running/queued/permission-pending; calls session/new without resume; failure, missing id or same id -> 'new failed ... still on <old>' with the old session kept; on success switches, resets proven/resumed/stalled, save() (sessionId null until the new session answers), writes one '[new session] old -> new' history line, re-applies mode/model/config-model and reports any REFUSED as an explicit 'SWITCHED but' non-success.

tests.new_socket_suite: 30/30 (real worker process, real unix socket, stub ACP engine): idle switch + boundary + model/mode on new id + unproven not persisted + no prompt side effect; normal prompt and /ping after; busy+queued refusal with queue intact; prompt racing /new waits and runs on new id; two concurrent /new -> one switch one refusal; adapter error / same id / missing id -> failure, old session kept; ACP_RESUME refused
